ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION |. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 12-J in the area bounded by:

A line 133.47 feet south of and parallel to West 54” Street; South Kedzie
Avenue; a line 233.47 feet south of and parallel to West 54" Street; and,
the public alley next west of South Kedzie Avenue.

To those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2, This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 5414-5422 South Kedzie Avenue
